data.gender_notes: Loving is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prema', meaning love. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the divine goddesses of love and compassion, such as Kamadevi and Lakshmi. The name Loving carries the meaning “Full of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Loving usually hope their child will grow to embody full of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Loving belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Full of Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Loving total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Loving" holds immense significance as it is associated with the divine goddesses of love and compassion. In Hindu mythology, Kamadevi, the goddess of passionate love and desire, and Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fertility, are believed to bestow love, happiness, and abundance upon their devotees. The name "Loving" serves as a continuous reminder of the divine presence of these goddesses and their blessings of love, compassion, and prosperity in our lives.
